manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find a FY2026 target confirmation form from a news-style definition list where the year evidence is in the preceding dd block.
search_queries: 更生看護専門学校 令和8年 修学支援新制度 確認申請書
更生看護専門学校 様式第２号 修学支援
steps: Find the 2025.08.19 news block stating 令和8年4月から修学支援新制度の対象機関として認定されました.
Use the next item link labeled 確認申請書（様式第２号）.
Resolve the direct PDF URL /kouseikansen/pdf/application_form2.pdf; the crawler's normalized no-slash page URL redirects to the HTTP canonical page.
Accept it as FY2026 because the preceding dd block supplies target-year support-system evidence and the PDF body contains 様式第２号 plus the school name.

reusable_rules: Treat a preceding dd block with 令和8年 and 修学支援新制度 as FY2026 evidence for the adjacent 確認申請書（様式第２号） link.
Keep dd blocks as candidate-local context so unrelated older or newer news items do not pollute the target-form anchor text.
Accept a stable application_form2.pdf filename when the adjacent news block supplies target-year evidence and the PDF body has 様式第２号 plus the school name.
anti_patterns: Do not use page-wide news archives as fiscal-year evidence for a single PDF link.
Do not infer the target year from unrelated entrance-exam or open-campus news items.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found the 2025.08.19 news block, verified the adjacent confirmation-form link, and verified the PDF body contains 更生看護専門学校 and 様式第２号.
